'''2007 Texas State Championship Gabe Taylor DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Gabe Taylor]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' IG-Tribute
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
